mvtec_ad.warning: MVTec AD does not provide official logical/structural image labels. This mapping is a supplementary semantic regrouping and must not be presented as an official MVTec AD three-class protocol.

visa.warning: VisA officially provides defect classes, not logical/structural image labels. Only unambiguous component Missing/Extra/Wrong Place masks are mapped to logical; images mixing logical and structural mask classes are excluded from the strict three-class view.

vid_ad.warning: VID-AD contains normal and logical samples but no structural class. Report class-coverage-aware metrics only; never report it as a complete three-class benchmark.
